# Difficulty Class

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [D20 Tests](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#DifficultyClass)*

A Difficulty Class (DC) is the target number for an [ability check](Ability-Check.md) or a [saving throw](Saving-Throw.md). *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[D20 Tests](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#D20Tests)").
